label: H.R. 139
title: Sunshine Protection Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

summary: Sunshine Protection Act of 2025 This bill makes daylight saving time the new, permanent standard time. States with areas exempt from daylight saving time may choose the standard time for those areas.
summary_short: Sunshine Protection Act of 2025 This bill makes daylight saving time the new, permanent standard time.
